verses.saheeh: The Most Merciful
verses.khattab: The Most Compassionate
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Compassionate One, God, exalted be He,
verses.romanUrdu: Rahman ne

verses.saheeh: Taught the Qur'an,
verses.khattab: taught the Quran
verses.jalalayn: ﻿has taught, whomever He will, the Qur'an.
verses.romanUrdu: Is Quran ki taleem di hai

verses.saheeh: Created man,
verses.khattab: created humanity
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He created man, the species [mankind],
verses.romanUrdu: Usi ne Insan ko paida kiya

verses.saheeh: [And] taught him eloquence.
verses.khattab: ˹and˺ taught them speech
verses.jalalayn: ﻿teaching him the [coherent] speech, utterance.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usey bolna sikhaya

verses.saheeh: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
verses.khattab: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The sun and the moon follow a reckoning, they move according to a [strict] calculation,
verses.romanUrdu: Suraj aur chand ek hisaab ke paband hain

verses.saheeh: And the stars and trees prostrate.
verses.khattab: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the grass, all stalkless vegetation, and the trees, that [vegetation] which possesses stalk, prostrate, comply with what is required of them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur taarey aur darakht sab sajda-reiz hain

verses.saheeh: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.khattab: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And He has raised the heaven and set up the balance, He has established justice,
verses.romanUrdu: Aasman ko usne buland kiya aur mizan qayam kardi

verses.saheeh: That you not transgress within the balance.
verses.khattab: so that you do not defraud the scales
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[declaring] that you should not contravene, that is to say, so that you may not do wrong, with regard to the balance, that [instrument] with which one weighs.
verses.romanUrdu: Iska taqaza yeh hai ke tum mizaan mein khalal na daalo

verses.uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.indopak: وَاَقِيۡمُوا الۡوَزۡنَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُوا الۡمِيۡزَانَ
verses.transliteration: waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana
verses.saheeh: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
verses.khattab: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And observe the weights with justice, fairly, and do not skimp the balance, [do not] decrease [the value of] what is being weighed.
verses.romanUrdu: Insaaf ke saath theek theek tolo (weigh) aur tarazu mein dandi (skimp ) na maaro

verses.saheeh: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
verses.khattab: He laid out the earth for all beings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the earth, He placed it, He fixed it [in place], for [all] creatures: man, jinn and others.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen ko usne sab makhlooqat (creatures) ke liye banaya

verses.saheeh: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.khattab: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In it are fruits and, the familiar, date-palms with sheaths, the spathes containing its flowers,
verses.romanUrdu: Usmein har tarah ke ba-kasrat laziz phal hain,khajoor ke darakht hain jinke phal ghilafon (sheaths) mein liptey huey hain

verses.saheeh: And grain having husks and scented plants.
verses.khattab: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and grain, such as wheat and barley, with husk, and fragrant herb.
verses.romanUrdu: Tarah tarah ke galley(corn) hain jinmein bhusa bhi hota hai aur dana (grain) bhi

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours, graces, will you deny? (tukadhdhibān is mentioned thirty one times; the interrogative is meant [to be understood] as an affirmative, judging by what al-Hākim [al-Naysābūrī] reported [by way of an isnād] from Jābir [b. ‘Abd Allāh al-Ansārī], who said, ‘The Messenger of God (s) was reciting surāt al-Rahmān to us, and when he completed it, he said, “What is wrong with you that you have been silent [throughout]? Verily the jinn are more responsive than you. Not once did I recite this verse to them — So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny? — but that they said, ‘Not one of your graces, our Lord, do we deny, for [all] praise belongs to You’ ”).
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rubb ki kin kin niyamaton ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
verses.khattab: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He created man, Adam, of dry clay (salsāl, a dry hollow mud producing an echo if tapped), resembling the potter’s (fakhkhār, clay that has been baked),
verses.romanUrdu: Insan ko usne thikri (potter) jaise sukhey sadey (rotten) huey gaarey se banaya (clay like [that of] pottery

verses.uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَخَلَقَ الۡجَآنَّ مِنۡ مَّارِجٍ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin
verses.saheeh: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.khattab: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and He created the Jann, the father of the jinn, namely, Iblīs, of a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Jinn ko aag ki lapat se paida kiya

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey Jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rubb ke kin kin ajaib-e-qudrat ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
verses.khattab: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lord of the two Easts, [the points of] the winter sunrise and the summer sunrise, and Lord of the two Wests: likewise [the two points of sunset].
verses.romanUrdu: Dono mashriq aur dono magrib, Sab ka maalik-o-parwardigar wahi hai

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins, tum apne Rubb ke kin kin qudraton ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
verses.khattab: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He has loosed the two waters, the sweet and the salty; [and so] they meet, in the perception of the eye.
verses.romanUrdu: Do samandaron (seas) ko usne chodh diya ke baham mil jayein

verses.saheeh: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
verses.khattab: yet between them is a barrier they never cross
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Between them there is a barrier, by His power, exalted be He. They do not overstep, neither of the two encroaches upon the other to become mixed with it.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir bhi unke darmiyan ek purdah hayal(barrier) hai jissey woh tajawuz (transgress) nahin karte

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins (insan), Tum apne Rubb ki qudrat ke kin kin karishmo ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
verses.khattab: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral
verses.jalalayn: ﻿From [both of] them, from the point at which they [seem to] meet — but which is actually from [only] one of the two, and that is, the salt water — is brought forth (yukhraju, passive, may also be read as active, yakhruju, ‘emerge’) the pearl and the coral (marjān, these are red pieces of shell, or small pearls).
verses.romanUrdu: In samandaron se Moti aur mongay (coral) nikalte hain

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rubb ki qudrat ke kin kin kamalaat ko jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verses.indopak: وَلَهُ الۡجَوَارِ الۡمُنۡشَئٰتُ فِى الۡبَحۡرِ كَالۡاَعۡلَامِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaala'lami
verses.saheeh: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
verses.khattab: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains
verses.jalalayn: ﻿His are the crafted ships [that sail] in the sea [appearing] like landmarks, like mountains in their tremendous size and height.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh jahaaz (ships) usi ke hain jo samandar mein pahadon (mountains) ki tarah unchey uthey huey hain

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aye jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rub ke kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
verses.khattab: Every being on earth is bound to perish
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Everyone who is on it, that is, [on] the earth, of animal beings, will perish (man, ‘who’, is used to indicate predominance of rational beings);
verses.romanUrdu: Har cheez jo is zameen par hai fanaa (perish) ho janey wali hai

verses.uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.indopak: وَّيَبۡقٰى وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الۡجَلٰلِ وَالۡاِكۡرَامِ ۚ
verses.saheeh: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.khattab: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿yet there will remain the countenance of your Lord, His Essence, [the countenance] of majesty, magnificence, and munificence, towards believers, through His graces to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur sirf tere Rubb ki jalil-o-kareem zaat hi baaki rehne wali hai

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rubb ke qudraton ke kin kin kamalaat ko jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
verses.indopak: يَسۡـَٔـلُهٗ مَنۡ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ ؕ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِىۡ شَاۡنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin
verses.saheeh: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
verses.khattab: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
verses.jalalayn: ﻿All that is in the heavens and the earth implore Him, either by way of speech or by their very state [of dependence on Him], for the strength which they require for worship, [for] provision, forgiveness and other things. Every day, [all the] time, He is upon some matter, something that He manifests in accordance with what He has decreed since pre-eternity, such as the giving of life, the bringing of death, exalting and abasing [individuals], giving abundantly and withholding, responding to a supplicating person and giving the one requesting [something] and so on and so forth.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen aur Aasmano mein jo bhi hai sab apni haajatein (needs) usi se maang rahey hain, har aan woh nayi shaan mein hai

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey jinn-o-Ins (insan), tum apne Rubb ki kin kin siffat-e-hameeda ko jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
verses.khattab: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We will attend to you, We shall turn to reckon with you, O you two heavy ones!, mankind and jinn.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey zameen ke bojho(loads), ankareeb hum tumse baaz purs (questioning) karne ke liye faarig huey jatey hain

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: (phir dekh lenge ke) tum apne Rubb ke kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlate ho

verses.uthmani: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
verses.indopak: يٰمَعۡشَرَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ اِنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تَنۡفُذُوۡا مِنۡ اَقۡطَارِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ فَانْفُذُوۡا ؕ لَا تَنۡفُذُوۡنَ اِلَّا بِسُلۡطٰنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ya ma'shara aljinni waalinsi ini istata'tum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
verses.saheeh: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
verses.khattab: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
verses.jalalayn: ﻿O company of jinn and humans, if you are able to pass through, to exit from, the confines, the regions, of the heavens and the earth, then pass through! — a command [meant] to challenge them to what they are incapable of [doing]. You will not pass through except with a sanction, [except] with some power, and you have no power for such a thing.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey giroh-e-jinn-o-Ins(insan) , gar tum zameen aur aasmano ki sarhadon se nikal kar bhaag sakte ho to bhaag dekho , nahin bhaag sakte iske liye bada zoar chahiye

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ki kin kin qudraton ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.indopak: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ ۙ وَّنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنۡتَصِرٰنِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: yursalu 'alaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani
verses.saheeh: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
verses.khattab: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Against you will be unleashed a heat of fire (shuwāz, can either mean that the flame thereof has no smoke or [that it does have it] with it) and a flash of brass, without any flame, and you will not be able to seek help, you will not be able to defend yourselves against this, nay, it will drive you to the site of the Gathering.
verses.romanUrdu: (Bhaagne ki koshish karogey to ) Tumpar aag ka shola aur dhoowan (smoke) chodh diya jayega jiska tum muqabla na kar sakogey

wbw.translation: you will (be able to) defend yourselves

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey Jinn-o-Ins (insan),tum apne Rubb ki kin kin qudraton ka inkar karogey

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا انْشَقَّتِ السَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani
verses.saheeh: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
verses.khattab: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when the heaven is split open, when it becomes open with [many] gates [in preparation] for the descent of the angels, and it turns crimson (wardatan, [literally, ‘a rose’], in other words, red like this [rose]), like tanned leather, red skins, in contrast to its [the heaven’s] usual appearance (the response to idhā, ‘when’, is [along the lines of] fa-mā a‘zama’l-hawli, ‘How great will be the terror then!’).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir (kya banegi us waqt) jab aasman phatega (split) aur laal chamdey (skin) ki tarah surkh (red) ho jayega

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Jinn-o-Ins (insan) (us waqt) tum apne Rubb ki kin kin qudraton ko jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.indopak: فَيَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لَّا يُسۡـَٔـلُ عَنۡ ذَنۡۢبِهٖۤ اِنۡسٌ وَّلَا جَآنٌّ ۚ
verses.transliteration: fayawmaithin la yusalu 'an thanbihi insun wala jannun
verses.saheeh: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
verses.khattab: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus on that day no man will be questioned about his sin, nor any jinn, about his sin; but they are questioned on some other occasion: By your Lord, We shall question them all [Q.15:92] (al-jānn in this instance and in what will follow denotes the jinn, and also in both cases al-ins denotes human beings).
verses.romanUrdu: Us roz kisi Insan aur kisi Jinn se uska gunaah puchne ke zaroorat na hogi

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir (dekh liya jayega ke) tum dono giroh apne Rubb ke kin kin ehsanaat ka inkar karte ho

verses.uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.indopak: يُعۡرَفُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ بِسِيۡمٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِىۡ وَ الۡاَقۡدَامِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: yu'rafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami
verses.saheeh: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.khattab: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The guilty will be recognised by their mark: blackened faces and bruised eyes; so they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.romanUrdu: Mujrim wahan apne chehron se pehchan liye jayenge aur unhein peshani ke baal aur paaon pakad pakad kar ghasita jayega

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt tum apne Rub ki kin kin qudraton ko jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِىۡ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ ۘ
verses.transliteration: hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona
verses.saheeh: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘This is Hell which the guilty [were wont to] deny!’
verses.romanUrdu: (Us waqt kaha jayega) yeh wahi jahannum hai jisko mujrimeen jhoot karar diya karte thay

verses.saheeh: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
verses.khattab: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They shall pass round, they shall pace, between it and boiling hot water, [water] of extreme temperature, which they are given to drink every time they call to be rescued from the heat of the Fire (ānin is defective, like qādin).
verses.romanUrdu: Usi jahannum aur khaulte (boiling) paani ke darmiyan woh gardish karte rahenge

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir apne Rubb ki kin kin qudraton ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
verses.khattab: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But for those who feared, that is, for every one of them, or for all of them together, the station of their Lord, the standing before Him for the Reckoning and therefore refrained from being disobedient to Him, there will be two gardens.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur har us shaks ke liye jo apne Rubb ke huzoor pesh hone ka khauf(darr) rakhta ho, do baagh (gardens) hain

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: Having [spreading] branches.
verses.khattab: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Both with (dhawātā, the dual form of the regular form dhawāt, with its lām [its third consonant] is changed into a yā’) [abundant] branches (afnān is the plural of fanan, similar [in pattern] to talal [atlāl]).
verses.romanUrdu: Hari bhari daaliyon se bharpur

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
verses.khattab: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In both of them there are two flowing springs.
verses.romanUrdu: Dono baaghon(gardens) mein do chashmey (springs) rawan

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
verses.khattab: In each will be two types of every fruit
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In both of them, of every fruit (fākiha) of [the fruits of] this world — or [it, fākiha, means] all those things in which one delights (yutafakkahu bihi) — there are two kinds, two varieties, one juicy, one dried, and those which in this world are bitter, like colocynth, will be sweet [therein].
verses.romanUrdu: Dono baaghon(gardens) mein har phal ki do qismein

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
verses.indopak: مُتَّكِـــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى فُرُشٍۢ بَطَآٮِٕنُهَا مِنۡ اِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ ؕ وَجَنَی الۡجَـنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: muttakieena 'ala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin
verses.saheeh: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
verses.khattab: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[They will be] reclining (muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier operated by an omitted [verb], that is to say, yatana‘‘amūna, they will enjoy bliss [while reclining]’) upon couches lined with [heavy] silk brocade, (istabraq) thick or coarse silk, the outer lining being of fine silk (sundus). And the fruits of both gardens will be near, so that it may be reached by the one standing up, the one sitting down or the one lying down.
verses.romanUrdu: Jannati log aisey farshon par takiye laga ke baithenge jinke astar dabiz resham ( silk brocade) ke hongey, Aur baagon ki daliyan phalon se jhuki padh rahi hongi

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.indopak: فِيۡهِنَّ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِ ۙ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ ۚ
verses.transliteration: feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.saheeh: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
verses.khattab: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In them, in the two gardens and what they comprise of upper chambers and palaces, are maidens of restrained glances, [restricting] their eyes to those spouses of theirs from among [either] the men or the jinn who are reclining, [maidens] who have not been touched, [who] have not been deflowered — and these [maidens] are [either] houris or women of this world who [will] have been created [anew], by any man or jinn before them.
verses.romanUrdu: In niyamaton ke darmiyan sharmili nigahon waliyan hongi jinhein in jannatiyon se pehle kisi insaan ya Jinn ne chuwa na hoga

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: As if they were rubies and coral.
verses.khattab: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is as though they are rubies, in their purity, and pearls, in their fairness.
verses.romanUrdu: Aisi khoobsurat jaisey hirey(diamonds) aur Moti

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
verses.khattab: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is the reward of goodness, [manifested] through obedience, anything but goodness?, [granted] through bliss?
verses.romanUrdu: Neki ka badla neki ke siwa aur kya ho sakta hai

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir aey Jinn-o-Ins (Insan),apne Rubb ke kin kin awsaaf-e-hameeda ka tum inkar karogey

verses.saheeh: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
verses.khattab: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And beside these, two mentioned gardens, there will be two [other] gardens, in addition, for those who feared the standing before their Lord.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur un do baaghon ke alawa do baagh aur hongey

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: Dark green [in color].
verses.khattab: Both will be dark green
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Deep green (mudhāmmatān, [this means that they are almost] black on account of the intensity of their greenness).
verses.romanUrdu: Ghaney sar-sabz o shadaab baagh

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
verses.khattab: In each will be two gushing springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In both of them will be two gushing fountains, rushing with water, unceasing.
verses.romanUrdu: Dono baaghon mein do chashmey (springs) fawwaron ki tarah ubaltey (gushing) huey

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
verses.khattab: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In both of them will be fruits and date-palms and pomegranates, the [latter] two [fruits] being from among these [fruits of the two gardens]; but it is also said that they belong to [the fruits of] some other [garden].
verses.romanUrdu: Un mein ba-kasrat phal aur khajurein aur anaar (pomegranates)

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: In them are good and beautiful women -
verses.khattab: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates
verses.jalalayn: ﻿In them, that is, in the two gardens and their palaces and what they comprise, are maidens [who are] good, in nature [and with], beautiful, faces.
verses.romanUrdu: In niyamaton ke darmiyan khoob seerat aur khoobsurat biwiyan

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.saheeh: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
verses.khattab: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Houris (hur, this means maidens with intense black eyes set against the [intense] whiteness [of the iris]) secluded, concealed, in pavilions, made of studded gems, annexed to the palaces, like boudoirs.
verses.romanUrdu: Kheymo (tents) mein theharayi hui hoorein (maidens)

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.indopak: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ ۚ
verses.transliteration: lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.saheeh: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
verses.khattab: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Untouched by any man before them, before these [soon-to-be] spouses of theirs, or jinn.
verses.romanUrdu: In jannatiyon se pehle kabhi kisi Insaan ya jinn ne unko na chuwa (touch) hoga

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
verses.indopak: مُتَّكِــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّعَبۡقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ ۚ
verses.saheeh: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
verses.khattab: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Reclining, namely, their spouses (muttaki’īna, syntactically, it is as [described] above) upon green cushions (rafraf is the plural of rafrafa, which can mean [either] ‘carpets’ or ‘cushions’) and lovely druggets (‘abqariyyin, the plural of ‘abqariyya, which are velvet carpets).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh jannati sabz-qaleeno (green cushions) aur nafees o nadir farshon (beautiful carpets) par takiye laga ke baithenge

verses.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ke kin kin inaamaat ko tum jhutlaogey

verses.uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.indopak: تَبٰـرَكَ اسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى الۡجَـلٰلِ وَالۡاِكۡرَامِ
verses.saheeh: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.khattab: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Blessed be the Name of your Lord, He of Majesty and Munificence (as [explained] above; the word ism is extra).
verses.romanUrdu: Badi barkat wala hai tere Rubb-e-Jaleel-o-Kareem (Majesty and Glory) ka naam
